description: This Scala source file defines the class ExecuteGrpcResponseSender, which manages sending responses over a gRPC stream in Apache Spark's SQL connect execution module. It handles response flow control, threading, and stream lifecycle management for executing Spark SQL plans with support for reattachable sessions.

classes.name: ExecuteGrpcResponseSender
classes.description: Manages sending responses over gRPC stream, including flow control, threading, and response lifecycle, supporting reattachable sessions.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Signals the sender to exit by setting an interrupted flag and waking up waiting threads.

methods.name: setDeadline
methods.description: Sets the deadline timestamp for the response sender to finish.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the response sending process, either in a background thread for reattachable sessions or directly in the current thread.

methods.name: enqueueProgressMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a progress report message to the response observer if reporting is enabled.

methods.name: updateDeadlineTimeNs
methods.description: Updates the deadline timestamp based on configuration or default maximum duration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main loop that consumes responses from the execution observer and sends them over gRPC, handling stream completion, errors, and deadlines.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response over gRPC, controlling flow based on whether the session is reattachable and stream readiness.

methods.name: wakeUp
methods.description: Notifies waiting threads to wake up from sleep or wait states.
